name: ClipCat
requirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or later / Windows 11, x64
short_description: ClipCat is a free Windows clipboard manager with local text and image history, search, tags, pinned clips, and 12 animated desktop cats.
description:
ClipCat is a free, open-source clipboard manager for Windows with a small desktop cat companion. It keeps copies of text and images in local history, so you can find and reuse something without returning to the original app.

When you copy text, your cat reacts by eating a fish. You can choose from 12 cats, each with its own appearance and animations. The companion stays on your desktop, and you can interact with it whenever you like.

For everyday work, ClipCat lets you search clipboard history, add tags, and pin frequently used items. It supports images and text, preserves HTML/RTF formatting, and lets you paste plain text when formatting would get in the way. The default Windows shortcut is Win+Shift+V; if registration fails, ClipCat attempts Ctrl+Shift+V.

Clipboard history stays on your device and is not encrypted. You can pause collection when copying sensitive information and delete saved clips when they are no longer needed. ClipCat does not require an account or cloud synchronization.

ClipCat supports Windows 10 version 2004 or later and Windows 11 on x64 PCs. Microsoft Store manages updates for the Store edition. The source code is available under the MIT license.
